leadText: Volume 1 is the first volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 1 is the first volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Pagaille au labo (« Lab Panic »)
Le grand départ (« The great departure »)
Le surnom (« The nickname »)
Premier combat contre un Dresseur (« First battle against a Trainer »)
Mystère électrique (« Electric mystery »)
Chantier dangereux (« Hazardous site »)
Le mystérieux garçon (partie 1) (« The mysterious boy (part 1) »)
Le mystérieux garçon (partie 2) (« The mysterious boy (part 2) »)

==Major events==
 
starts his journey to beat the Pokémon League.
and set off on their journeys to tell Black about the broken Pokédexes.
Black meets Andy and learns about Triple Battles.
meets , the president and manager of the Pokémon talent agency, the BW Agency.
White forcefully employs Black into the BW Agency.
Black and White encounter Team Plasma.
Angered that Team Plasma's Ghetsis has caused people to release their Pokémon, Black tries to stop them from doing so again.
Black is attacked by a young man who claims he can hear the voices of Pokémon.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Black's Tepig "Tep" in PS462.
Cheren's in PS462.
Bianca's in PS462.
Black's Galvantula "Tula" in PS465; revealed in PS467.

==Trivia==
A special edition with a new cover was available during 48H BD 2021.
